comments.body:
As I have recently rented from them and this posting was my only point of reference, I would like to share my experience here briefly.

They are legitimate, and the communication over FlatFox worked well. They are more straightforward than other Swiss agencies that request additional information, in person viewing, documents and references.

The problems/issues I found with them are that they seem to have grown the company fast while not sorting out their operational department or wanting to save money here. Even though things get eventually sorted, communication tends to be a one-way street.

Their postings on FlatFox are partly misleading. A notice that the displayed pictures do not represent the current state of the flats was missing for my flat. After asking, the reply was that the pictures were only a couple of weeks old, but by the time I moved in, this was utterly inaccurate.

Furthermore, it is essential to be specific and explicit about the room you are renting in the WG and to ensure that this is also specified in the contract. This wasn't the case with me (contract and FlatFox communication differed), and it caused some problems on arrival. Someone else was occupying the room and was required to move rooms first. Not the best start. 

I agreed through (in the FlatFox communication, in the contract, it wasn't mentioned) to rent a partly (community areas) furnished WG, but it was not. A simple couch, couch table and some balcony furniture, as well as some cutlery, were there. A shelf or additional storage in the living room was missing. 

The most annoying thing was that no lights were installed or provided. Furthermore, I expected the Internet to be provided as it said all bills (except electricity) to be included/provided, but it was not. Unfortunately, I did not take screenshots of the initial listing though; definitely do that.

The cleanliness of the room was also ok, but requires a good basic clean.
comments.author: Shofield41610
